title: Legal Myths That Will Land You in Prison || r/BadLegalAdvice
summary: LegalEagle debunks pop-culture legal myths, including the sovereign-citizen loophole, its Posse Comitatus roots and the lost 13th Amendment.

assertions.quote: The sovereign citizen idea originated with a group founded by Christian minister William Gail in the 1970s.

verdicts.note: The Titles of Nobility Amendment was never ratified, and courts reject the argument.

assertions.quote: Now all of this of course has been thoroughly rejected by the courts.
sovereign citizens have been known to file notices of leans against property for the purpose of harassing the true owner
